items.name: exists_nat_gt

items.name: archimedean_iff_nat_le

items.name: archimedean_iff_nat_lt

items.name: exists_lt_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [Archimedean M] [AddLeftStrictMono M] {a : M},
  0 < a → ∀ (b : M), ∃ n, b < n • a

items.name: archimedean_iff_int_le

items.name: exists_nat_ge

items.name: exists_nat_one_div_lt
items.type:

  0 < ε → ∃ n, 1 / (↑n + 1) < ε
